intro.text: You wake up in a strange glowing room. Three mysterious doors stand before you.

dragon.text: You open the red door. Heat races through your body as scales spread across your skin, your frame expands, and powerful wings unfold behind you. You have transformed into a dragon.

wizard.text: You open the blue door. Blue light coils around your arms as your clothes reshape into layered robes and a carved staff appears in your hand. You have transformed into a wizard.

vampire.text: You open the green door. A chill slips through your body as your skin pales, your senses sharpen, and your teeth lengthen into fangs. You have transformed into a vampire.

dragonCrossroads.text: You spread your wings and leap into the sky. Mountains rise to the north, an ancient forest stretches west, and a walled kingdom glitters in the east. Where will Drakon go?

dragonMountains.text: Drakon climbs toward the frozen peaks. A ruined fortress clings to one cliff, while a thunderous roar rolls from a cavern beneath the highest summit.

dragonFortress.text: Broken towers surround a courtyard. A gigantic golden egg rests on a pedestal, and a sealed stone door trembles with something moving behind it.

dragonEgg.text: The enormous golden egg begins to glow. Tiny cracks spread across its shell, and something inside taps back when Drakon touches it.

dragonHatch.text: The golden shell cracks apart in warm light. A tiny dragon emerges, blinking up at Drakon before letting out a squeaky roar.

dragonProtectHatchling.text: Drakon curls one immense wing around the hatchling. Heavy footsteps begin approaching from deep within the fortress.

dragonGuardian.text: The stone doors burst open. An ancient silver dragon enters, studying Drakon and the hatchling with glowing blue eyes.

dragonPeace.text: The guardian lowers his head. He explains that the hatchling is the last heir of a vanished dragon clan and asks whether Drakon will protect it.

dragonBlessing.text: The guardian presses one claw to Drakon's brow. Silver light spreads across his scales, granting him the power to shield the hatchling from harm.

choices.text: 🌤️ Leave the fortress with the hatchling

dragonHatchlingLore.text: The guardian reveals that the hatchling carries the ember-heart of the First Dragon. Raised with mercy, it could restore dragonkind. Raised through fear, it could rule by fire.

choices.text: 🤝 Swear to raise it with mercy
👑 Claim the hatchling as your heir

dragonFight.text: Claw and flame crash through the chamber. The guardian is ancient but powerful, and the hatchling cries between the battling dragons.

dragonFightMercy.text: Drakon turns his back on the guardian to shield the hatchling. The silver dragon halts his attack, recognizing that Drakon chose protection over pride.

dragonFightVictory.text: Drakon overwhelms the guardian and stands over the defeated silver dragon. The fortress bows to the victor, but the hatchling watches in frightened silence.

choices.text: 👑 Claim the fortress and its hoard

dragonEscape.text: Drakon bursts through the broken roof with the hatchling or egg clutched safely beneath him. Behind him, the fortress collapses into the mountain mist.

choices.text: 🏔️ Build a nest in the peaks

dragonShell.text: The shattered shell glitters with ancient runes. One fragment pulses with magical energy while another contains a faded map.

dragonRune.text: The rune burns into Drakon's claw and fills his mind with visions of dragons returning to the skies. The magic offers power, but demands a vow.

dragonMap.text: The map reveals three hidden places: a buried dragon city, a volcanic crown vault, and a sanctuary deep in the forest.

dragonCarryEgg.text: Drakon carefully lifts the golden egg. It is surprisingly warm. As he carries it away, the fortress begins to shake violently.

dragonRuins.text: Drakon's call echoes through the fortress. Ghostly dragon voices answer from below, guiding him toward a stairway buried under rubble.

dragonCrypt.text: Beneath the fortress lies a crypt of stone dragon statues. At its center rests a black crown beside a silver oath-ring.

dragonRival.text: A crimson dragon erupts from the cavern, larger than Drakon and scarred by countless battles. It claims the entire mountain range as its territory.

choices.text: 🎁 Offer part of your future hoard

dragonRivalParley.text: The crimson dragon respects Drakon's nerve. It offers a trial: recover a stolen ember gem from human hunters and earn the right to share the peaks.

dragonRivalFight.text: The two dragons collide above the peaks. Lightning flashes across their wings as each searches for an opening.

choices.text: 🤝 Break off and offer a truce

dragonRivalMercy.text: Drakon pins the crimson dragon but refuses the final blow. The rival yields, impressed by strength restrained by honor.

dragonRivalAlliance.text: The crimson dragon accepts Drakon's offer. Together, they could guard the mountains or descend upon the lands below.

dragonHunters.text: Drakon finds the hunters camped beside a frozen lake, the ember gem chained inside an iron wagon.

choices.text: 🤫 Steal the gem without harming anyone

dragonShrine.text: At the summit stands a shrine carved with three symbols: a flame, a storm cloud, and a moon. Ancient magic waits for Drakon's choice.

dragonShrineEgg.text: The shrine reacts to the golden egg. The three symbols blaze at once, offering to awaken a rare power within the unborn hatchling.

dragonFlameTrial.text: Drakon is surrounded by living fire. To pass, he must decide whether flame is a weapon, a shield, or a light.

dragonStormTrial.text: A storm tears at Drakon's wings. He can surrender to its fury, master its rhythm, or guide it away from the valley below.

dragonMoonTrial.text: Moonlight reveals three possible selves: a solitary guardian, a hidden oracle, and a conqueror crowned beneath an eclipse.

dragonForest.text: Drakon descends into an ancient forest where trees rise higher than castle towers. He hears singing from a glowing grove and frightened cries near a hunter's road.

dragonForestHatchling.text: Drakon hides the hatchling beneath the ancient canopy. Forest spirits gather, curious but wary of the young dragon.

dragonGrove.text: Tiny luminous spirits circle Drakon. Their queen offers a bargain: protect the grove from iron-cutters, and the forest will shelter dragons forever.

dragonIroncutters.text: Armored loggers advance with enchanted axes. Drakon can frighten them, destroy their machines, or negotiate with their captain.

dragonGroveDemand.text: The spirit queen offers a seed of living gold, but warns that taking it selfishly will bind Drakon's fate to the forest.

choices.text: 🌱 Take the seed and guard it

dragonForestHunters.text: Hunters have trapped a wounded griffin and a young human scout. Both stare at Drakon in terror.

dragonGriffin.text: The griffin bows in gratitude and offers to guide Drakon to a hidden sky-temple.

choices.text: 🤝 Ask the griffin to join you

dragonScout.text: The rescued scout reveals that the kingdom is preparing weapons against dragons, but not everyone inside the walls supports the plan.

dragonHeartTree.text: At the center of the forest stands the heart-tree, its roots wrapped around an ancient dragon skeleton. A voice asks what Drakon seeks.

dragonForestSanctuary.text: The forest opens into a hidden valley untouched by humans. Warm caves, clear rivers, and ancient nesting grounds wait in silence.

choices.text: 👑 Declare yourself ruler of the valley

dragonKingdom.text: Drakon circles the kingdom. Ballistae line the walls, but crowds gather below, some terrified and some awestruck. The royal castle raises a white banner.

dragonKingdomDiplomacy.text: The queen meets Drakon in the open courtyard. She offers peace if he helps stop a rebellion led by nobles who want every dragon destroyed.

dragonRebellion.text: The rebel nobles barricade themselves in the old armory with dragon-killing weapons.

choices.text: 💀 Destroy the rebels and seize power

dragonTreaty.text: After tense negotiations, the queen agrees to a treaty: dragons may live freely if they protect the realm from greater threats.

choices.text: 👑 Rewrite it with Drakon as high protector

dragonThroneDemand.text: The court falls silent. The queen offers a choice: rule beside her as protector, or fight for the crown.

dragonTribute.text: The kingdom offers gold, livestock, and a tower of Drakon's own if he promises not to attack.

dragonKingdomSiege.text: Fire and stone fill the sky as Drakon attacks the walls. He can break the defenses, target only the weapons, or stop before civilians are harmed.

dragonKingdomInfiltration.text: Using ruined aqueducts, Drakon enters the city beneath the walls and discovers a laboratory building artificial dragons.

dragonLostCity.text: Beneath the desert lies a city built for dragons. Its empty throne recognizes Drakon as a possible heir, but ancient guardians demand proof of character.

dragonCrownVault.text: Inside a volcanic vault floats the Crown of Ash. It can command lesser dragons, but each command slowly turns the wearer to stone.

dragonEndingProtector.text: Drakon chooses protection over conquest. In time, dragons return to the world under his watch, and the hatchling grows beside him as the first symbol of a peaceful new age.

dragonEndingDragonKing.text: Drakon becomes the first dragon king of a renewed age. Some follow him with love, others with fear, but every sky now knows his name.

dragonEndingTyrant.text: Drakon rules through terror. Kingdoms pay tribute, rival dragons kneel, and the horizon glows red beneath an empire built by flame.

dragonEndingRedeemed.text: Drakon spares a defeated enemy and breaks the cycle of vengeance. His mercy becomes the deed for which later generations remember him.

dragonEndingHiddenNest.text: Drakon vanishes into the high peaks and raises the hatchling far from war. Their hidden nest becomes the quiet beginning of a new clan.

dragonEndingRuneGuardian.text: Bound to an ancient vow, Drakon becomes guardian of dragonkind's oldest magic, appearing whenever dragons face extinction.

dragonEndingMountainLord.text: Drakon claims the peaks and rules them alone. Travelers leave offerings at the mountain passes, and none cross without his permission.

dragonEndingTwinFlames.text: Drakon and the crimson rival rule the mountain skies together. Their alliance ends centuries of dragon feuds and begins an age of shared strength.

dragonEndingFeared.text: Drakon's enemies scatter wherever his shadow falls. He survives, powerful and unchallenged, though few dare approach him without trembling.

dragonEndingHonored.text: Drakon becomes known as a dragon of honor. Humans, spirits, and creatures of the wild learn that his word is stronger than iron.

dragonEndingFireHeir.text: The hatchling awakens with a living sun in its chest. Drakon raises the fire heir, and together they rekindle the fading bloodlines of dragons.

dragonEndingStormHeir.text: The hatchling hatches beneath thunder, born with stormlight in its wings. Drakon becomes mentor to the first storm dragon in an age.

dragonEndingMoonHeir.text: The hatchling emerges silver-eyed and moonlit. Under Drakon's care, it becomes a bridge between dragons, spirits, and the magic of night.

dragonEndingStormLord.text: Drakon becomes master of thunder and wind. Storms answer his roar, and sailors learn to watch the clouds for the shape of his wings.

dragonEndingMoonOracle.text: Drakon trades conquest for prophecy. From a hidden shrine, he guides dragons and kingdoms through visions of futures that might still be changed.

dragonEndingForestGuardian.text: Drakon becomes protector of the ancient forest. New dragon nests appear beneath the colossal trees, guarded by spirits and flame alike.

dragonEndingCursedHoard.text: Drakon gains a magnificent hoard, but every treasure carries a whisper of hunger. He becomes richer than kings and less free than any prisoner.

dragonEndingSkyWarden.text: Drakon forms an alliance of dragons, griffins, and enchanted creations. Together they patrol the skies and protect those who cannot defend themselves.
